brief.topic: The model returned JSON. Validate it anyway
brief.audience: PMs and engineers wiring LLM output into product logic

coreInsight: Treat model output as untrusted input: validate shape and meaning, retry once with the error, fall back safely, and only then let code act on it.

caption.opening: Model output is untrusted input, even when it’s perfectly formatted JSON.
body:
Put a check between the model and your code:
→ Schema check: fields and types
→ Retry once, passing the error back
→ Safe fallback if it’s still invalid
→ Only then let the app act
Shape isn’t meaning. Also check value ranges, that IDs exist in your system, and log every failure so you can see what breaks.
